en: Zhang Sanfeng: You must be Lv 10 or higher to join the Wudang Sect.
Zhang Sanfeng: Wudang martial arts follow the way of softness. Would you like to join?
You are now a disciple of the Wudang Sect!
Zhang Sanfeng: Wudang martial arts follow the way of softness.
Zhang Sanfeng: To practise the Pure Yang art you need Mugwort, Skyreach, Sesame, Rainflower, Poria and Peace Herb. Find me these herbs and I'll teach you a thing or two.
Zhang Sanfeng: Very good, very good.
Zhang Sanfeng: I have lately devised new swordplay and a new fist style. Let me test your grasp of the way of softness.
Zhang Sanfeng: Which overcomes the hard with the soft: the fist or the sword?
Fist
Sword
Zhang Sanfeng: In truth, both do. But I'll teach you the Taiji Fist, and you can work out the rest for yourself.
Zhang Sanfeng: In truth, both do. But I'll teach you the Taiji Sword, and you can work out the rest for yourself.
Yu Daiyan: Wudang puts chivalry first.
Yu Daiyan: Every Wudang disciple should know the Tao Te Ching by heart.
Please teach me.
Yu Daiyan: Laozi, founder of Taoism, wrote the Tao Te Ching: 37 chapters on the Way, then 44 on Virtue. Its depths take years to fathom, so first learn five chapters by heart.
Yu Daiyan: Chapter 1: The Way that can be told is not the eternal Way; the name that can be named is not the eternal name.
Yu Daiyan: Chapter 25: Man follows Earth, Earth follows Heaven, Heaven follows the Way, and the Way follows what is natural.
Yu Daiyan: Chapter 33: Who knows others is wise; who knows himself is enlightened. Who conquers others has force; who conquers himself is strong.
Yu Daiyan: Chapter 41: The great square has no corners, the great vessel is finished late, the great sound is hard to hear, the great image has no form.
Yu Daiyan: Chapter 42: The Way gave birth to One, One to Two, Two to Three, and Three to all things.
Yu Daiyan: Have you learned them by heart? Then I'll test you. Listen closely.
Yu Daiyan: "The great image has no form." In Chinese, "great image" can also read "elephant". So what does "great image" mean here?
The greatest form
An animal
Yu Daiyan: To learn the Coil Sword you need a fine sword forged from the best metal. Go and bring me some Platinum.
Yu Daiyan: Very good, very good.
Yu Daiyan: To learn the Soft Cloud Sword, you must wield a Zhenwu.
Squire Liu: I'm very keen on high-grade ore. If you have any, please sell it to me. I'll pay 500 taels for Platinum Ore and 1000 for Black Gold Ore.
Sell
Don't sell
Sell Plat Ore
Sell Gold Ore
Squire Liu: Well? Where's your ore?
"Hoeing the grain at noon, sweat drips onto the soil..." Plump, glistening ears of rice and lush green vegetables everywhere - one look down and I know harvest time has come again.
For a traveller, nothing hurts more than homesickness.
Niuniu's Mom: My Niuniu talks all day about becoming a hero, and now he's run off who knows where. I'm worried sick!
I'll find him
They say everyone in the Yipin Hall is a master fighter.
Xixia has plenty of fun places to go, and it's easy to get around. What a great place!
Xixia is big, but everything here is orderly. That's what made me move here for good.
Miss Chunxiang, someone asked me to give you this.
Chunxiang: This... who is it from?
Think about it, Miss, and I'm sure you'll know who sent it.
Chunxiang: ...Very well. Tell him to come visit me at home tomorrow.
Xixia's guards take their duty seriously, so we all live in peace.
The Capital
Welcome to the Xixia branch of Tongren Hall, for the finest medicines.
Young one, you have good aptitude. I'll teach you Basic Step. Would you like to learn?

This is the Xixia branch of Fuwei Escorts. We're swamped, and a shipment has to reach the Yangzhou general store in a hurry. You look like a capable fighter. Take it there for us and these 500 taels are yours.
Might I trouble you with a matter?
Please go ahead, Your Honor. No need for ceremony.

I hear someone from our country has opened an underground casino in Dali. I'm busy hunting an escaped murderer and have no time to go there. Could you find out about this person for me? You'll be well rewarded!
I'll go now
I can't help
Thank you, good sir. Take care on the road.
Your Honor, the man does exist. He is...
Good, good! Please accept these 500 taels as a small token of thanks.
That must be the one I'm looking for. I'd better head straight back.
I'm going to be a hero!
Niuniu: I'm going to be a hero and go everywhere fighting for justice, just like you!
Encourage
The bad guys out there are really nasty. You're still little and haven't even learned the basics. How are you going to fight for justice?
Hmm, you're right. Then I'll go fight for justice when I grow up.
That's it. Learn the basics first, and later you can go beat up bad guys.
I'll go home, then. I found this sword, but I don't need it now, so you can have it.
So young, and so much spirit!
Thank you! You're the best!

Ping Yizhi: I've just made an antidote that cures every poison under heaven. But its ingredients are scattered far and wide, and I'm looking for someone to gather them. Fetch them for this old man and I'll give you six Dragon Dew.

Ping Yizhi: Good! I need Mugwort, Skyreach, Sesame, Rainflower, Poria and Peace Herb, from Mt. Song, Mt. Heng, Mt. Wudang, Zhongnan, Mt. Hua and Mt. Emei. Find the herb gatherers on those mountains; they'll give you the herbs.

Ping Yizhi: I need Mugwort, Skyreach, Sesame, Rainflower, Poria and Peace Herb, from Mt. Song, Mt. Heng, Mt. Wudang, Zhongnan, Mt. Hua and Mt. Emei. The herb gatherers there will give them to you. Have you been to every one?
Got them all
Not yet
Ping Yizhi: You didn't bring enough ingredients. The medicine has failed.
Li Yu: Sigh... "My robe hangs looser, yet I have no regret; for her I pine and waste away."
Are you in love with someone, friend?
Li Yu: Sigh... but she has never shown me the slightest sign. Why must anyone be as miserable as me? Could you tell her how I feel?
I'll talk to her
Can't help you
Li Yu: Her name is Chunxiang. This lotus fan is my love token. Please give it to her for me.
She accepted it, and she wants you to visit her home tomorrow.
Li Yu: I can never repay you! This ring is a family heirloom. Please take it!
